ignore.*.stories.tsx: Stories repeat the same render shape by design.
ignore.packages/client/src/primitives: Primitives wrap the same platform component variant by variant.
ignore.tests, mocks, e2e, tools: Not production logic; a new-clones-only gate for tests comes later.
ignore.generated files: Fix the generator, not the output: *.gen.*, storybook.requires.ts, uniwind-types.d.ts, packages/db/drizzle.

reasons.baseline: The one entry in .jscpd-baseline.json is the Claude and Codex converter row helpers; each adapter keeps its own, and a shared helper would be shallow.
